title: AshTech
description: A tech modpack centered around automation, machinery, and space exploration.
body:
AshTech is a technology focused modpack built around automation, machinery, and space exploration.

The pack includes popular tech mods such as Create, Mekanism, and Ad Astra, giving players multiple ways to build factories, automate resource production, generate power, and explore beyond the Overworld.

With Create, you can build mechanical contraptions and production lines, while Mekanism adds advanced machines, power systems, and resource processing. Ad Astra expands the experience further by allowing you to build rockets and travel to other planets.

You can also expect a variety of QoL mods, improved world generation, and other additions to enhance the overall experience.

If you want to host your own server, download the included Server Pack.

Alternatively, you can join the official AshTech server, which is available directly through the multiplayer server list.
